product_metadata.title: Eucalyptus Garland with Flowers - 17 Champagne Roses - Lush, Natural Looking Eucalyptus and Flower Garland Decor, Floral Garland Greenery for Wedding Table Decor with Abundant Vines, Rose Leaves
features: 🌿NATURAL FULL & LUSCIOUS: Our artificial eucalyptus greenery flower garlands are realistic and handmade so offers a beautiful, natural, rustic look. With 17 rose flowers and a variety of rose, eucalyptus and boxwood leaves, it provides tons of texture and volume. Each artificial garland eucalyptus and rose leaf is printed with veins to replicate a real live plant.

🌿FLEXIBLE & LOW MAINTENANCE: Our champagne rose garland is made from high quality, non-toxic, UV resistant and waterproof material. The faux silver dollar silk eucalyptus and rose leaves are soft to touch and vines are made with wood like plastic stems. The garlands are flexible and easily bent into any fixed shape. There is no watering needed so they remain spring fresh looking and are easy to wipe clean. It is long lasting, won't wilt, fade or easily damaged.

🌿CREATE BEAUTIFUL DISPLAYS: There are so many ways to use our eucalyptus rose garland. It is perfect for kitchen decor, wedding decorations, backdrop, centerpiece displays, arches, vine decor , flower wall decor, Christmas, thanksgiving greenery, fireplace mantle garland, banquet tables, fence posts, eucalyptus table runner,farmhouse garland, vines for room decor, baby showers or eucalyptus rose garland wreath. Create a wedding arch or hanging flower display for a focal point.

🌿PERFECT SIZE: One per pack, each faux champagne rose and eucalyptus floral garland is 6.5 foot long and 5.9" wide, has approx.100 round boxwood, 150 eucalypt and 200 rose leaves. With 17 realistic roses, let your space grow into a lush sanctuary with your rose eucalyptus garland. It can also be given as a special gift for your friends or loved ones.

🌿GIVEBACK TO A CHARITY/OUR GUARANTEE: We believe in giving back. For every purchase you make, a homeless person in America is given a meal. On behalf of those in need, thanks – you’re awesome. 🌿 We’re so sure our stunning floral garlands for decor will fully satisfy you from all points of view (uniqueness, size and material quality) that if you are not satisfied we offer an exchange or full refund.
